## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: A guard test fails when any registry row with a level other than docs names...

The system SHALL ensure that a guard test fails when any registry row with a level other than docs names an enforcer path that does not exist or lacks a recorded failing commit, and it ships with a self-test proving it detects that violation.

#### Scenario: A guard test fails when any registry row with a level other than docs names...

WHEN `add-rule-to-enforcer-registry-with-expiring-waivers` is implemented
THEN A guard test fails when any registry row with a level other than docs names an enforcer path that does not exist or lacks a recorded failing commit, and it ships with a self-test proving it detects that violation.

### Requirement: prove_enforcer <rule-id> demonstrates failure on the recorded commit for...

The system SHALL ensure that prove_enforcer <rule-id> demonstrates failure on the recorded commit for every seeded rule, including the openspec-path-stability, CI-coverage and skill-loader-frontmatter guards.

#### Scenario: prove_enforcer <rule-id> demonstrates failure on the recorded commit for...

WHEN `add-rule-to-enforcer-registry-with-expiring-waivers` is implemented
THEN prove_enforcer <rule-id> demonstrates failure on the recorded commit for every seeded rule, including the openspec-path-stability, CI-coverage and skill-loader-frontmatter guards.

### Requirement: The AGENTS.md rule-to-enforcer table is generated from the registry, and a...

The system SHALL ensure that the AGENTS.md rule-to-enforcer table is generated from the registry, and a drift check fails when they diverge.

#### Scenario: The AGENTS.md rule-to-enforcer table is generated from the registry, and a...

WHEN `add-rule-to-enforcer-registry-with-expiring-waivers` is implemented
THEN The AGENTS.md rule-to-enforcer table is generated from the registry, and a drift check fails when they diverge.

### Requirement: A waiver with a past expiry date, or one missing a reason or approver, fails...

The system SHALL ensure that a waiver with a past expiry date, or one missing a reason or approver, fails the waiver guard.

#### Scenario: A waiver with a past expiry date, or one missing a reason or approver, fails...

WHEN `add-rule-to-enforcer-registry-with-expiring-waivers` is implemented
THEN A waiver with a past expiry date, or one missing a reason or approver, fails the waiver guard.

### Requirement: The registry documents the escalation rule (a docs-level rule corrected...

The system SHALL ensure that the registry documents the escalation rule (a docs-level rule corrected twice is flagged for promotion) as an interface for intervention records, and adds no correction store or mining logic.

#### Scenario: The registry documents the escalation rule (a docs-level rule corrected...

WHEN `add-rule-to-enforcer-registry-with-expiring-waivers` is implemented
THEN The registry documents the escalation rule (a docs-level rule corrected twice is flagged for promotion) as an interface for intervention records, and adds no correction store or mining logic.
